name: Mazda
description: Mazda over a generic OBD-II dongle (HS-CAN, UDS). Tuned for 2016 SkyActiv (MX-5 ND and siblings). Reads modules on the HS-CAN bus only -- body/comfort modules on MS-CAN need an MS-CAN switchable adapter.

panel.title: All modules (OBD dongle)
panel.hint: Module scan for SkyActiv-era Mazdas (≈2012+) over the ordinary OBD dongle — each HS-CAN module's own fault memory, deeper than generic OBD-II. Pick the adapter top-right, ignition ON, then scan. Body/comfort modules sit on MS-CAN and need a switchable adapter — they won't show here.
panel.scanBusy: Walking the HS-CAN modules through the dongle… (absent addresses time out quietly)

actions.label: Live extras
actions.busy: Asking the modules for the Mazda-specific values…
actions.title: Mazda live extras
actions.hint: Reads Mazda-specific values the generic list doesn't carry — oil temperature, ATF, battery state, cluster fuel and odometer.

actions.label: Snapshot
actions.busy: Listening to the car's broadcast frames (~10s)…
actions.title: Mazda snapshot (broadcast)
actions.hint: Passive listen — nothing is sent to the car. Decodes the frames the car broadcasts anyway: doors, fuel, gear, ignition, odometer.
